sections.visual_description: A minimalist editorial illustration showing flowing streams of digital data represented as elegant curved lines and geometric shapes passing through processing gates. Perl code fragments as architectural elements in the background. Clean composition with negative space, suggesting data transformation and filtering. Black and white pen and ink sketch, New Yorker style, with subtle red accents highlighting key data points.
sections.caption: Perl时代的代码隐喻

sections.visual_description: A conceptual diagram showing multiple smartwatches and fitness devices emitting data streams that converge into a powerful river of information. The visualization includes abstract human figures in motion, heart rate curves, step counts represented as ascending stairs, and sleep patterns as gentle waves. The composition suggests massive scale and continuous flow. Architectural precision with geometric patterns, monochromatic ink sketch with crimson highlights on key data nodes.
sections.caption: 可穿戴设备数据流

sections.visual_description: An abstract visualization featuring probability distribution curves (bell shapes), statistical symbols (summation sigma, integral signs), and algorithmic networks represented as interconnected nodes. The composition shows geometric shapes—spheres, cubes, and planes—in a three-dimensional space, suggesting the mathematical foundations of machine learning. Elegant, intellectual atmosphere with clean lines and sophisticated negative space. Black and white ink drawing with subtle vermilion accents on mathematical symbols.
sections.caption: 数学与算法的交响

sections.visual_description: A futuristic interior view of an automobile cockpit showing a large dashboard display with holographic elements. The scene includes abstract representations of neural networks, knowledge graph connections as glowing nodes and edges, and voice interaction waves emanating from the driver's position. The composition balances technical precision with human-centered design. Minimalist editorial style with loose confident strokes, architectural drawing aesthetic, monochromatic with strategic use of cinnabar red for emphasis.
sections.caption: AI智能座舱的愿景

sections.visual_description: A conceptual illustration showing a path or road leading toward a horizon where multiple technological streams converge—data pipelines, AI neural networks, human figures representing expertise, and geometric symbols of innovation. The composition suggests continuity, growth, and the intersection of technology and human wisdom. Elegant minimalist design with generous white space, the path as a sweeping curve creating visual movement. Black and white pen and ink with carmine red highlights on key convergence points.
sections.caption: 未来的数据之路
